$comment: Single source of truth for the Item API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: item
title: Item
description: A row with a picture or icon, a title, a description and actions. Use it for lists of people, files or settings.
thumb: Ada LovelaceOwner

actions.description: Buttons, a badge or a chevron at the end.

href.description: Makes the whole row a link.

ItemGroup.description: A bordered list of items with lines between them.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: An outlined item with an avatar and a button, and a muted item with an icon.

examples.title: Group
examples.description: Items in a list with lines between them.

examples.title: As links
examples.description: When the whole row goes somewhere, make the item a link and end it with a chevron.

a11y: An item group is a list (role="list" and "listitem"), so screen readers say how many items there are.
A clickable row is one <a> or <button>; don't put other buttons inside a link item.
Icons and chevrons are hidden from screen readers; the title says what the row is.
